finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. Now takes either. [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. Unset flags used to be `false`. Now `undefined` means off. [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in `build.js`. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist here.

Next: nothing. Errors gone, exit 0.
